description: Calculates BCEA pay for a pay period: ordinary hours, weekday/Saturday overtime (1.5x), Sunday work (1.5x if ordinarily worked, else 2x), and public holiday work (s18). Flags breaches of overtime limits and checks the BCEA earnings threshold (employees above it have no statutory overtime entitlement).

annual_earnings.description: Regular annual earnings, to test the BCEA threshold (optional)

ordinarily_works_sunday.description: True if Sunday is a normal workday for this worker (paid 1.5x instead of 2x). Default false

ordinary_daily_hours.description: Hours in a normal shift, for public holiday minimum. Default 9

ordinary_hours.description: Ordinary hours worked in the period

public_holiday_hours.description: Hours worked on public holidays in the period. Default 0

public_holiday_is_ordinary_workday.description: True if the holiday fell on a day the worker would normally work (BCEA s18(2)); false if not (s18(3)). Default true

sunday_hours.description: Hours worked on Sundays in the period. Default 0

weeks_in_period.description: Weeks covered, used to check the 10h/week overtime cap. Default 1

name: overtime_and_premium_pay
title: Calculate overtime, Sunday and public holiday pay
